about: Six horizon waves (slowdown, prices and rates, trade shocks, health and weather, scams, AI and work) read as a weekly search of the reputable forums (WEF, IMF, RBI, World Bank, OECD, CERT-In). Only news titles, dates and links are kept, exactly as published; a title lands on a wave by its regex, and news only ranks a wave, it never writes a step. Add a wave or a forum here, never in code.

patterns.name: Slowdown: the economy losing speed
patterns.query: (slowdown OR recession OR contraction OR downturn OR growth) (site:weforum.org OR site:imf.org OR site:rbi.org.in OR site:worldbank.org OR site:oecd.org OR site:cert-in.org.in)

patterns.name: Prices and rates: what things cost and what money costs
patterns.match: inflation|deflation|interest rate|repo rate|policy rate|food prices|fuel prices|cost of living|price (rises|rising|surge|surges|jump|jumps|spike|spikes)
patterns.query: (inflation OR deflation OR "interest rate" OR "repo rate" OR "policy rate" OR "food prices" OR "fuel prices" OR "cost of living" OR prices) (site:weforum.org OR site:imf.org OR site:rbi.org.in OR site:worldbank.org OR site:oecd.org OR site:cert-in.org.in)

patterns.name: Trade shocks: tariffs, bans and broken supply chains
patterns.query: (tariff OR "trade war" OR "trade shock" OR "trade dispute" OR "export ban" OR "import ban" OR sanctions OR "supply chain") (site:weforum.org OR site:imf.org OR site:rbi.org.in OR site:worldbank.org OR site:oecd.org OR site:cert-in.org.in)

patterns.name: Health and weather: outbreaks and extremes
patterns.query: (pandemic OR outbreak OR epidemic OR heatwave OR "heat wave" OR flood OR cyclone OR drought OR "air quality" OR smog OR monsoon) (site:weforum.org OR site:imf.org OR site:rbi.org.in OR site:worldbank.org OR site:oecd.org OR site:cert-in.org.in)

patterns.name: Scams: the newest ways people are tricked
patterns.query: (scam OR fraud OR ponzi OR phishing OR "digital arrest" OR "identity theft" OR "pyramid scheme") (site:weforum.org OR site:imf.org OR site:rbi.org.in OR site:worldbank.org OR site:oecd.org OR site:cert-in.org.in)

patterns.name: AI and work: what machines are doing to jobs
patterns.query: ("artificial intelligence" OR AI OR automation OR deepfake OR chatbot OR "large language model" OR "machine learning" OR robot) (site:weforum.org OR site:imf.org OR site:rbi.org.in OR site:worldbank.org OR site:oecd.org OR site:cert-in.org.in)
